constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (configured_by_auth_user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (participant_id) REFERENCES savings_participants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK ((((scope_type = 'GLOBAL'::text) AND (participant_id IS NULL)) OR ((scope_type = 'PARTICIPANT'::text) AND (participant_id IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (actor_real_auth_user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (participant_id) REFERENCES savings_participants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (usuario_contexto_affiliate_id) REFERENCES affiliates(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['ACTIVE'::text, 'TERMINATION_PENDING'::text])) OR ((approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (first_expected_contribution_date IS NOT NULL) AND (process_snapshot IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (import_batch_id) REFERENCES savings_import_batches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (participant_id) REFERENCES savings_participants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK ((((identity_status = 'RESOLVED'::text) AND (affiliate_id IS NOT NULL) AND (participant_type = 'AFFILIATE'::text)) OR ((identity_status = ANY (ARRAY['AMBIGUOUS'::text, 'ORPHAN'::text])) AND (affiliate_id IS NULL) AND (participant_type = 'LEGACY_UNRESOLVED'::text)) OR ((identity_status = 'NON_AFFILIATE'::text) AND (affiliate_id IS NULL) AND (participant_type = 'NON_AFFILIATE'::text))))
FOREIGN KEY (affiliate_id) REFERENCES affiliates(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (import_batch_id) REFERENCES savings_import_batches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_savings_history_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin raise exception 'SAVINGS_APPEND_ONLY_HISTORY' using errcode='55000'; end $function$
